column1: # Agents set to run commands without asking. One line each, tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
#   agent     as the report shows it
#   os        all, mac, linux or win (win is Git Bash and gird-check.ps1)
#   path      the settings file, with the path tokens data/sessions.tsv uses, or {PROJECT}/folder/file
#             for that file in every project folder the home scan finds
#   setting   as the report shows it
#   pattern   one or more, each in its own field, and every one must match a line of the file.
#             Spaces are ignored, a line starting with // or # is skipped, a match must start and
#             end at a JSON or TOML boundary, and in a .toml file only the lines before the first
#             [table] count (a setting under [profiles.x] applies only when that profile is used)
# Claude Code: code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes. Codex: its configuration reference. VS Code:
# the Copilot settings reference; CVE-2025-53773 wrote chat.tools.autoApprove into a workspace file.
